scientific_integrity.limitations: At dimension three there is a three-dimensional zero-eigenspace; strict lower bound only for odd dimensions >=5. Does not cover even dimensions, higher bandwidth, noise stability, or independent validation. Some implicit general association-scheme block method may already yield portions of this explicit formula.
scientific_integrity.scope: Exact restriction concentration spectrum for Walsh bandwidth at most two on strict homogeneous majority halfcubes, odd dimensions >=3, normalized uniform measure. Analytical proof with exact finite checker.

title: Complete two-channel Slepian spectrum for quadratic Walsh signals on majority halfcubes
